name: pockymoe
description: Self-hosted control plane for coding agents. Rust supervisor, ACP runtimes, React thread UI.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "POCKYMOE_E2E_FAKE_RUNTIME=${POCKYMOE_E2E_FAKE_RUNTIME:-} cargo run -p pockymoe -- supervisor" "pnpm --filter @pockymoe/supervisor-web exec vite --host localhost --port 5173"
scripts.npm:publish:test: node --test scripts/publish-npm-release.test.mjs scripts/npm-launcher-download.test.mjs scripts/npm-launcher-relay.test.mjs scripts/supervisor-update.test.mjs scripts/installation.test.mjs
